# Toy problem

Planted defects: `## Known Barriers` is missing entirely, `## What Remains Conjectural` is empty, and
the terminated approach states no reopening condition.

## Target Statement

Every even integer greater than two is the sum of two primes.

## What Is Proved

Nothing about the target. A computation verifies the statement for all even n up to 10^6.

## What Remains Conjectural

## Known Results

Verified computationally far beyond our range by others; see the literature on the Goldbach
conjecture.

## Equivalences

None recorded.

## Where the Difficulty Lives

In controlling the error term in the circle-method minor arcs.

## Terminated Approaches

### Sieve-theoretic bound

Status: terminated 2026-07-01
Why: the parity problem obstructs any purely sieve-theoretic route.

## Stopping Criteria

A published barrier result covering the circle-method approach, or six months without a new bound.
